traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Thinking all Ashokan inscriptions are in Brahmi script (Ignore Kandahar bilingual edicts).
Confusing 'Major Rock Edicts' with 'Minor Rock Edicts' regarding the mention of Ashoka’s name.
Assuming inscriptions were exclusively administrative; they were also personal (Dhamma-related).

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Distributed from Kandahar to Mysore
  • Centralized authority reflected in uniformity

Personalities

  • Ashoka: The primary issuer
  • James Prinsep: Deciphered Brahmi in 1837

Epigraphic Mindmap

  • Types of Inscriptions
    • Major Rock Edicts (MRE): Social/Ethical codes (14 in total)
    • Minor Rock Edicts (mre): Personal/Bio data (Maski/Gujarra mention 'Ashoka')
    • Pillar Edicts (PE): Seven major pillars
    • Cave Inscriptions: Barabar hills (Ajivikas)
